meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 会用 claude-mem 的观察记录创建可筛选的知识库;之后把知识库内容载入对话,供你像聊天一样提问,回答都基于该语料库。
howto.when: 当你想把 claude-mem 的观察记录做成某个主题的知识库、询问过去的工作规律,或把特定领域的经验整理成可问答的资料时触发。

say.text: 建一个上月 bugfix 的知识库,然后问其中最常见的 bug
say.note: 先后构建并载入,再提问
调用 list_corpora 显示列表

howto.what_en: Claude can build filterable knowledge bases from claude-mem observations, load them into an AI session, and answer natural-language questions based only on that corpus.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to turn claude-mem observations into a focused topic knowledge base, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a hooks knowledge base from claude-mem observations, limited to the claude-mem project.
Create a knowledge base of last month's bugfixes, then ask about the most common bug.
